newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIUM'S COMPETITION COUNCIL SUSPENDS ACTIVITIES.
newsitem.headline: BELGIUM'S COMPETITION COUNCIL SUSPENDS ACTIVITIES.

text.p: Belgium's competition council said on Tuesday it would suspend its activities until authorities enabled it to work properly.

"The council voted unanimously to suspend its activities as long as the measures necessary to exercise its legal powers have not been adopted by the competent authorities," the council's president Christine Schurmans said in a statement.
The council is an administrative legal committee of magistrates and experts set up to help safeguard free competition in Belgium.
